'''Nysad''' was one of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] many [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]] guards and servants.

==Biography==
Nysad was a [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]]<ref name="Insider60" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Weekly21" /> who worked as a guard for the<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Nysad}}</ref> [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]<ref name="Jabba">{{FactFile|38|JAB 1-4|Jabba the Hutt}}</ref> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], whom the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] was fiercely loyal to. He stood guard on Jabba's [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]],<ref name="CCG" /> the ''[[Khetanna/Legends|Khetanna]]'',<ref name="CrossSections">''[[Star Wars: Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> during the Hutt's trips to [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]],<ref name="CCG" /> a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Mos Eisley">{{DB|location|moseisley|Mos Eisley}}</ref>

Nysad was present in Jabba's Throne Room during the Max Rebo Band's performance of Jedi Rocks and Luke Skywalker's arrival to the Palace.<ref name=":0">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

Nysad was aboard the [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']] at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]] when [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was to be executed. He erupted from a top-opening hatch built into the deck, at the opposing end to the deck-mounted cannon, as the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] wielding Skywalker turned to face him. Nysad managed to fire off one shot, which Skywalker deflected, before slicing Nysad across his chest with his lightsaber. Nysad subsequently fell through the hatch from whence he came.<ref name=":0" />

==Personality and traits==
Nysad had [[Color/Legends|red]] skin<ref name="Hasbro" /> and was fiercely loyal to Jabba.<ref name="CCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Lathe.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The image of Nysad mistakenly identified as [[Lathe/Legends|Lathe]] by Decipher.]]
Nysad first appeared in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film ''[[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi]]''. The character's helmet was made to cover up the seam at the back of the Nikto mask.<ref name="Costumes: The Original Trilogy">''[[Star Wars Costumes: The Original Trilogy]]''</ref> He was first named in the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] continuity in the [[1998]] ''[[Jabba's Palace Limited]]'' expansion for the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] by [[Decipher]].<ref name="SWCCG">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Nysad}}</ref> His name is an [[Tuckerization|anagram]] of card designer [[William Wible]]'s nickname "Sandy".<ref name="SWCentralized">{{YouTube|video=xt4wGy1be0I|text=Solving The Mystery Behind The FIRST Live-Action Thrawn|channel=StarWarsCentralized|name=Star Wars Centralized|date=2025-07-17|nobackup=1}}</ref>

Deciper has used the image of Nysad on the card representing [[Lathe/Legends|Lathe]] for the ''[[Tatooine Limited]]'' set. Lathe was later [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] to be a different character. Hasbro produced an action figure modeled after Nysad (named "Nikto Gunner") in 2009 as part of their Legacy series. The figure came packaged with an anti-personnel laser cannon, but the character never used such a weapon in the film (it was used by a different Nikto, [[Vizam/Legends|Vizam]]).
